The '''Advanced Deployment Harpoon''', also known as the '''ADH''' or simply as the '''Harpoon''', was a hostile docking system that allowed a shielded [[Rope/Legends|tether]] to be fired from one [[Starship/Legends|ship]] to another, anchoring itself on the [[Hull/Legends|hull]] of the targeted ship. From there, people and equipment could be easily moved between the ship firing the harpoon and the targeted vessel. Originally built for search and rescue purposes, military companies took an interest in the technology for use in combat operations after seeing it deployed successfully for its original purpose.<ref name="Harpoon">{{TORcite|exp=ons|type=codex|Advanced Deployment Harpoon (ADH)}}</ref>

During the [[Third Galactic War]], the [[Hidden Chain]] starships ''[[Champion's Glory]]'', ''[[Fortune's Folly]]'' and ''[[Seeker's Vigil]]'' used Advanced Deployment Harpoon to capture the ''[[Spirit of Vengeance II]]''.<ref name="TOR:SoV">{{TORcite|exp=ons|type=flashpoint|Spirit of Vengeance}}</ref>
